lowConfidence.reason: Stilson & Smith PDF could not be text-extracted in this session; form re-derived from the lesson's block diagram (four identical one-poles with −k feedback) and checked numerically ((1+j)^4 = −4, so k = 4 puts a pole on the jω axis at the cutoff). Algebra is standard; cited paper not re-read.

'Birdies' is informal jargon with no authoritative definition; slew source is the electronics slew-rate article; minBLEP 'stores its difference from an ideal step' describes common implementations rather than quoting Brandt.
